whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Garage Kitchen,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.5★ reviews on Bhootnath Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online orders and table bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur quick directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/garagekitchen

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Garage Kitchen, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with online menu viewing and direct WhatsApp food ordering for your location on Bhootnath Road in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, pricing, aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
